text:
Leah Morgan: Quick thought  run a one-week "Bridge the Gap" recognition push focused on onboarding mentors and cross-team helpers. Want to coordinate nominations + 4 micro-spot awards. Thread to align ops, budget, Intl handling.

Diego Alvarez: Nice. Timeline? budget per award?

Leah Morgan: Nominations open Mon -> Thurs noon, review Fri morning, winners on Friday All-Hands. $120 per award (e-gift + small digital badge). Total ~$500 incl. card fees. Need Finance ok.

Camille Ruiz: Will mentors be nominated by mentees only or anyone?

Leah Morgan: Anyone can nominate, but add a flag for "mentee nomination" to highlight mentor impact. Keep reasons short (<=40 words) and ask for one concrete example (link or short note).

HR-Bot: Nomination form: https://forms.gle/bridgethegap (fields: nominee, nominator optional, team, mentee-nom? yes/no, 40-word reason, example link optional, reward opt-in: e-gift/shoutout-only)

Anil Desai: Can managers nominate direct reports? Also, can someone win multiple micro-awards across weeks?

Leah Morgan: Managers may nominate but mark relationship. Repeat winners allowed. Add checkbox if recipient won in last 3 months for reviewer context.

Priya Singh: Finance note: we'll need recipient emails and country for payouts. For non-US, prefer e-gift or charity option to avoid customs/VAT. I'll pre-check limits.

Marta Kovacs: I can help moderate submissions and format winners slide. What selection criteria are we using?

Leah Morgan: Short rubric in form description: mentorship/impact (1-4), cross-team help (1-4), initiative (1-4). Reviewers average scores; ties decide by panel vote.

HR-Bot: Reminder set: post in #general 2 days before close and morning of close. Also DM nominators if required fields missing.

Diego Alvarez: I'll volunteer to be a reviewer Friday AM. Can we set a 30-min review block?

Leah Morgan: Yes please. Adding reviewers: Diego, Marta, two People Ops folks. I'll send invite.

Priya Singh: I'll draft the Finance approval request; ping me with finalists list and payout emails after review.

Marta Kovacs: Suggest adding a "digital onboarding badge" in addition to e-gift so mentors get lasting recognition. I can mock up a badge.

Leah Morgan: Love it. Adding digital badge + Slack emoji. Low-friction and good signal.

Anil Desai: Ops Q: international mentors might prefer charity donation instead of gift. Can we include that option?

Leah Morgan: Yes, add charity option. Also collect preferred payout email or donation org for winners.

HR-Bot: Action items added to form description for nominators and reviewers.

Leah Morgan: Action list:
- Leah: update form with repeat-winner checkbox + rubric (today)
- Marta: badge mock + winners slide template (tomorrow)
- Diego: review block Fri 9:30am
- Priya: finance approval flow once finalists selected
- HR-Bot: reminders per schedule

Diego Alvarez: Thanks  will RSVP to review slot. Anything else?

Leah Morgan: That's it  closing thread, will post links and calendar invites. Please @mention me on any nomination that seems HR-sensitive. :handshake:
